default.mainlandApplicantNotes: No nationality-specific faculty acceptance policy is established by the configured source. Apply through the international-applicant route only after the official Fall 2028 policy is published; never infer willingness from names or lab-member backgrounds.
default.internationalApplicationRoute: Department or graduate-school PhD application; Fall 2028 rules need official verification.

Massachusetts Institute of Technology.mainlandApplicantNotes: MIT EECS publishes an international-student application and funding route. Its information letter says admitted international students may hold research assistantships with stipend and full tuition, and it does not publish a minimum GPA cutoff. This is general international policy, not a guarantee for applicants from mainland China or for Fall 2028.
Massachusetts Institute of Technology.internationalApplicationRoute: Apply through MIT EECS graduate admissions; verify Fall 2028 English-test, deadline and funding language when that cycle opens.

Carnegie Mellon University.mainlandApplicantNotes: CMU CSD publishes the same basic admitted-PhD funding commitment for domestic and international students and a separate English-language requirement. This is general international policy, not a faculty-level promise or a Fall 2028 confirmation.
Carnegie Mellon University.internationalApplicationRoute: Apply to the relevant CMU doctoral program; verify Fall 2028 program, English-test and funding rules on the official page.
